fields.label: Finish Item

fields.label: Consumption Unit
fields.options:
Per Pcs
Per Pack
Per Ctn

fields.label: Meters Per Default UOM
fields.description: Fetched from the Item's Meters per Default UOM. When set (> 0), Gross Qty converts Consumed Qty (meters) into purchase units before adding wastage; when blank/0, Gross Qty is just Consumed Qty inflated by Wastage %.

fields.label: Gross Qty
fields.description: 2026-09-28 (feature v3) - judgment call on your formula (it read as inverted/ambiguous - flagged in CHANGES and towel_costing_totals.py): if Meters Per Default UOM is set, Gross Qty = (Consumed Qty / Meters Per Default UOM) x (1 + Wastage % / 100); otherwise Gross Qty = Consumed Qty x (1 + Wastage % / 100). Tell me if it should work differently.

fields.label: Rate
fields.description: Fetched from that Item's most recently dated Item Price when Item Code is set - not filtered to a specific Price List.

fields.label: Amount
fields.description: = Consumed Qty x Rate. Not in your original field list - added to support the Costing Total table's Trims Charges rollup. Flag if you'd rather compute that differently.
